newsitem.title: USA: Fox urged to move "Married with Children".
newsitem.headline: Fox urged to move "Married with Children".

text.p: Two members of Congress Tuesday urged the Fox Television Network to move its popular comedy, "Married with Children", from early Sunday evening to a later time.

"Married with Children regularly features vulgar language and crude sexual innuendoes, often treats parents as buffoons, and generally contradicts and undermines the values most parents try to instill in the children -- such as respect for elders, personal responsibility and civility," Sen. Joseph Lieberman and Rep. Lamar Smith wrote the network.
Lieberman is a Connecticut Democrat and Smith is a Texas Republican. They said early evening shows should be reserved for programs the whole family could watch.
"Married with Children" had been shown at 9:30 p.m. on Saturdays and is being moved to 7 p.m. on Sundays.
